digest.component_or_area: rebar search CLI and library interface
propositions: rebar search currently returns full ticket bodies and comments, consuming excessive context (203 KB for typical queries) when discovery only needs enough context to identify and select a ticket
search lacks --output flag support and rejects --output json as unrecognized rather than providing JSON output, while list already supports --full for body opt-in
no durable ticket-summary field exists in the event schema; until one does, search must derive bounded summaries from descriptions and snippet context from match positions

default search must return a bounded eight-field SearchResult (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with summaries and snippets capped at 240 characters and normalized whitespace
search must support --full to return legacy full TicketState JSON and --output json|llm to control output format, rejecting incompatible flag combinations like --full --output llm
positive free-text matches must produce case-preserving snippets bounded to 240 characters centered on the match, while predicate-only and negation queries return null snippet
